answer.summary: API types check failed because the committed TypeScript types are out of date with the Java DTOs. Regenerating types from the API produces diffs that make scenario_revision_number and scenario_version_current/latest/scenario_simulations_count optional, and the script asks for a regeneration before committing. The PR changed these DTOs without regenerating types, so re-running will fail the same way until the types are regenerated and committed.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
